tagging_basis: AQA 7037 specification codes; AS units mapped to the matching A-level leaf

units.summary: Outline how human factors affect the water cycle.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of familiar impacts such as deforestation on runoff and infiltration; recall.

units.summary: Analyse two figures on lake and river temperature change by location and latitude, 1970-2010.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of a map and a latitude graph; no knowledge recall required.

units.summary: Using UK river flow data and own knowledge, assess factors affecting likelihood of flooding.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO1=2 AO2=4 short assess applying drainage basin and flood factor knowledge to gauging data.

units.summary: With a studied tropical rainforest, evaluate attempts to mitigate the impacts of climate change.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark case-study essay requiring evaluation of mitigation strategies; case study required.

units.summary: Outline characteristics of a pediment.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a single desert landform; recall.

units.summary: Interpret changes in rainfall and vegetation patterns across north Africa between two maps.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 comparison of two maps from different periods; patterns and change, no recall.

units.summary: Using a figure on desertification causes and own knowledge, assess potential impacts of desertification.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO1=2 AO2=4 short assess linking known impacts to novel locational data.

units.summary: With studied hot deserts, assess potential climate change impacts on landform development.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark case-study essay linking climate change to landform development; synoptic climate knowledge.

units.summary: Outline the sequence in which a sea stack develops.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a familiar erosional landform sequence; recall.

units.summary: Analyse a map of Vietnamese coastal zones and graphs of coastal erosion vulnerability.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of linked map and graphs with data manipulation; no recall.

units.summary: Using a figure on West African coastal challenges and own knowledge, assess management approaches.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO1=2 AO2=4 short assess applying coastal management knowledge to a novel region.

units.summary: With studied coastal environments, assess potential climate change impacts on landform development.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark case-study essay linking sea level change to landforms; case study required.

units.summary: Outline processes leading to the development of a corrie.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a familiar glacial landform; recall.

units.summary: Analyse graphs of cumulative length change and mass balance for Scandinavian glaciers.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of two linked line graphs; patterns, anomalies, manipulation.

units.summary: Using a figure on Alpine challenges and opportunities, evaluate opportunities for a sustainable future.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO1=2 AO2=4 short evaluation applying management knowledge to a novel region.

units.summary: With studied cold environments, assess potential climate change impacts on landform development.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark case-study essay linking climate change to cold landforms; evaluation of change.

units.summary: Outline processes involved in forming ocean ridges.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a constructive margin feature; recall.

units.summary: Interpret data on the changing frequency of tropical storms, 1980-2018.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 interpretation of trend data; no recall.

units.summary: Using data on the Hunga Tonga eruption and tsunami, assess challenges in responding to the event.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark assess (AO1=4 AO2=5) combining volcanic and tsunami hazards with response knowledge.

units.summary: Assess whether carbon cycle changes cause increasingly frequent and severe tropical storms.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark to-what-extent evaluation requiring a synoptic link between carbon cycle and storm causes.

units.summary: Evaluate the usefulness of the Hazard Management Cycle in minimising wildfire impacts, using a studied event.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay with a named wildfire event; evaluates a model against outcomes.

units.summary: Outline processes involved in mineral nutrient cycling in an ecosystem.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a familiar ecosystem process; recall.

units.summary: Analyse data on global biodiversity by species category in 2019.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of categorical chart data with manipulation; no recall.

units.summary: Using a food web diagram and own knowledge, assess the impact of human activity on a lagoon ecosystem.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark assess (AO1=4 AO2=5) applying energy flow knowledge to an unfamiliar food web.

units.summary: Assess how far carbon cycle changes are making the future of coral reefs increasingly uncertain.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark to-what-extent evaluation requiring a synoptic link to the carbon cycle.

units.summary: With a British Isles plagioclimax, assess factors affecting its change and development.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay requiring a named ecosystem and weighing of natural and human factors.
